scope: v0.26.5 RC1 attempt 30 replaces the Games-page WPF Viewport3D shelf implementation with the validated V7 native Direct3D 11 GPU shelf architecture while preserving the existing WPF shell, platform actions, Customization settings and full-screen model viewer compatibility. The exact production source 61404b14e81e9fd24e4189485f8e2eb4d7c804ce is green on the same commit across Platform Models, Unified Cursor, Performance, Download Refresh and GameCube. HuymaierGpuPlatformShelves.ps1 V7 is the final Games 3D presentation owner and must load after V6 compatibility helpers. In 3D Models mode retain two separate responsive shelves: Providers on top and Consoles below, with each shelf keeping its own selection and together using most of the available Games canvas rather than fixed 188px strips or the earlier compact top-half layout. Preserve existing platform-select action IDs and frozen emulator platform open behavior; Left/Right browses within the focused shelf, Up/Down changes shelf/content layer, A/Cross opens the selected platform and X/Square opens the full-screen model viewer. Every platform with a successfully compiled/loaded GLB must remain a 3D model regardless of scroll distance: distance may only change whether native D3D11 draws the item in the current shelf viewport. It must never evict the GPU asset, clear the model because it is far from selection, or restore the platform icon after successful GPU load. The fallback icon is shown only before first cache/load completion or when a model genuinely cannot be compiled/loaded. Native D3D11 owns the turntable animation and rendering. WPF owns only navigation, labels, selection chrome and D3DImage composition. The production renderer uses one shared hardware D3D11 device/context, immutable GPU vertex/index buffers, mipmapped BGRA textures, cached sampler states and a process-wide shared asset cache keyed by HC3D cache path; shelf item instances reference shared assets and update rectangles/selection/visibility without re-reading GLBs or rebuilding GPU resources during scrolling. User GLBs are compiled once in the background by hidden x64 HuymaierGpuShelfAssetCompiler.exe into persistent %LOCALAPPDATA%\Huymaier Console\3D Model Cache HC3D assets keyed by source length, last-write UTC ticks and quality. Shelf texture quality is capped at 512px maximum dimension before GPU upload; subsequent launches and navigation reuse current HC3D cache files unless the source GLB changes. Preserve the audited material data needed by the 36 original models, including transformed/multiple UVs, base/diffuse and emissive images, sampler wrap metadata, alpha, material colors, specular/roughness/clearcoat/unlit approximation and material-only models. Normal release bytes continue to contain zero GLBs. The native renderer DLL is x64 and built with static MSVC runtime /MT so Windows 11 does not need a separately installed VC runtime for the shelf renderer. HuymaierGpuShelfHost.dll is x64 and bridges the native D3D11/D3D9Ex shared surfaces into WPF D3DImage without CPU frame readback. HuymaierGpuShelfAssetCompiler.exe is x64. Per-monitor DPI awareness is mandatory: D3D render-target dimensions and item rectangles are converted from WPF logical units to current physical monitor pixels, state survives surface recreation, and DPI changes recreate/replay the native surface correctly. Preserve the full original 36 model filename contract and context-aware provider mapping, including keeping the Xbox PC provider distinct from the Original Xbox hardware Xbox.glb. Settings for Platform visuals, Icon card size, 3D shelf model size and Open 3D Models Folder remain only under Settings > Customization. Preserve the PowerShell protected-automatic-variable audit with no reserved $Host/$PID collisions; preserve native-only unified browser cursor ownership and serialized PID/GUID state writes; preserve zero retired atlas/static-preview/generated-model payload. Exact-source validation must compile/run the native D3D11 WARP shader/readback proof, validate the persistent HC3D compiler including 1024x512 to 512x256 BGRA downsample, render a cached textured HC3D through immutable GPU buffers/mipmapped texture/model shader, validate V7 final ownership/full-height/no-distance-icon behavior and DPI awareness, and preserve V6 material/viewer compatibility tests. The staged candidate gate must independently require and load HuymaierD3D11ShelfRenderer.dll, HuymaierGpuShelfHost.dll and HuymaierGpuShelfAssetCompiler.exe, verify x64/native exports, execute the packaged WARP smoke and packaged HC3D compiler, prove V7 load order and reject distance-to-icon/WPF shelf residency behavior. Preserve all previously proven GameCube, Downloads, Performance/native streaming, Sony Raw-HID, Game Bar, Wii/Dolphin, provider concurrency, installer rollback/tamper, Steam/Nintendo ownership, shelf artwork persistence, Downloads history and frozen PS1/PS2/PS3 behavior. Upload only if exact-source GPU/V7 revalidation, x64 FSE host build, release-shaped package build, installer/integrity fault injection, stabilization, staged native cursor/streaming/GameCube, staged V7 GPU shelf gates, active-download library stability, Steam owned-library behavior and final hash verification all pass together.
